svg.title: MegaMoE kernel time, OFF and ON
svg.desc: MegaMoE kernel time on GB200 for a DeepSeek-V4-Pro layer without (OFF) and with (ON) four helper slots per rank holding replicas: (a) power-law routing at EP4 and EP8 with 8K and 16K tokens/rank; (b) 61 layers with routes sampled from the trace at EP8 and 8,192 tokens/rank; dashes mark balanced routing.
